from IPython.display import HTML, display

import _helpers as h
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
dmps = h.load_dmps()
erbs = h.load_erbs()

dept_data = {}
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    dd = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    de = h.department_erbs(dd, erbs)
    dept_data[dept] = {"dmps": dd, "erbs": de}

repo_colors = {
    "4TU.ResearchData": "#4e183c",
    "Zenodo": "#742459",
    "OSF": "#a12d76",
    "Figshare": "#f5bddd",
}
repo_order = ["4TU.ResearchData", "Zenodo", "OSF", "Figshare"]

## Data Storage Location


```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    import pandas as pd
    title_by_purpose = {
        "all": "DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions by Department",
        "scientific": "Scientific DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions by Department",
        "educational": "Educational DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions by Department",
    }
    rows = []
    for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
        sub = h.filter_department(pdf, dept)
        total = len(sub) or 1
        for _, r in h.storage_split(sub).iterrows():
            rows.append({
                "Department": h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS[dept],
                "Category": r["Category"],
                "DMPs": r["DMPs"],
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Department", color="Category",
                 barmode="stack", height=500,
                 text="DMPs",
                 title=title_by_purpose[pkey],
                 color_discrete_map={
                     "Using TU/e storage": "#742459",
                     "Not using TU/e storage": "#FAE1F0",
                 })
    fig.update_layout(
    yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
    legend={
        "orientation": "h",
        "yanchor": "bottom",
        "y": 1.00,
        "xanchor": "left",
        "x": 0,
    },
    margin={"t": 100},
    legend_title_text="",
)
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>Note: TU/e storage solutions include TU/e Network Drive, SURF Research Drive, Microsoft SharePoint/Teams, and Microsoft OneDrive.</i></p>')
    print(h.render_department_abbreviations())

    solution_titles = {
        "all": "TU/e Data Storage Choices by Department",
        "scientific": "Scientific DMPs with TU/e Data Storage Choices by Department",
        "educational": "Educational DMPs with TU/e Data Storage Choices by Department",
    }
    df = h.storage_solution_by_department(pdf)
    df["Department"] = df["Department"].map(h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS)
    sol_order = ["TU/e Network Drive", "SURF Research Drive",
                 "Microsoft SharePoint/Teams", "Microsoft OneDrive"]
    solution_colors = {
        "TU/e Network Drive": "#742459",
        "SURF Research Drive": "#a12d76",
        "Microsoft SharePoint/Teams": "#367DB3",
        "Microsoft OneDrive": "#4BAFD9",
    }
    df["Share"] = df.groupby("Department")["DMPs"].transform(lambda s: s / s.sum())
    df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Share", y="Department", color="Solution",
                 barmode="stack", height=500,
                 text="Share",
                 title=solution_titles[pkey],
                 category_orders={"Solution": sol_order},
                 color_discrete_map=solution_colors,
                 custom_data=df[["Label"]])
    fig.update_traces(texttemplate="%{x:.0%}", textposition="inside")
    fig.update_traces(hovertemplate="%{y} · %{fullData.name}<br>%{customdata[0]}<extra></extra>")
    fig.update_layout(
        yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
        xaxis={"tickformat": ".0%", "title": ""},
        legend={
            "orientation": "h",
            "yanchor": "bottom",
            "y": 1.00,
            "xanchor": "left",
            "x": 0,
        },
        margin={"t": 100},
        legend_title_text="",
    )
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>Note: Percentages are shares of storage '
          '<b>choices</b>, not of DMPs. A DMP can select multiple storage options.</i></p>')
    print(h.render_department_abbreviations())
    print('<br>')
    print('</div>')
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    import pandas as pd
    title_by_purpose = {
        "all": "Trusted Repository Choices by Department",
        "scientific": "Scientific DMPs with Trusted Repository Choices by Department",
        "educational": "Educational DMPs with Trusted Repository Choices by Department",
    }
    rows = []
    for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
        sub = h.filter_department(pdf, dept)
        for _, r in h.repository_breakdown(sub).iterrows():
            if r["Repository"] not in repo_order:
                continue
            rows.append({
                "Department": h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS[dept],
                "Repository": r["Repository"],
                "Choices": r["DMPs"],
            })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Choices", y="Department", color="Repository",
                 barmode="stack", height=500,
                 text="Choices",
                 title=title_by_purpose[pkey],
                 category_orders={"Repository": repo_order},
                 color_discrete_map=repo_colors)
    fig.update_layout(
        yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
        legend={
            "orientation": "h",
            "yanchor": "bottom",
            "y": 1.00,
            "xanchor": "left",
            "x": 0,
        },
        margin={"t": 100},
        legend_title_text="",
    )
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>Note: Counts are repository '
          '<b>choices</b>, not DMPs. A DMP can select multiple repositories. Data only include choices indicating a use of a trusted repository. Trusted repositories included here are: 4TU.ResearchData, Zenodo, OSF, Figshare.</i></p>')
    print(h.render_department_abbreviations())
    print('</div>')

#| tags: [hide-all]
#| output: asis

for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    slug = h.DEPT_SLUGS[dept]
    dd_all = dept_data[dept]["dmps"]
    de = dept_data[dept]["erbs"]
    print(f'<div class="dept-panel" id="dept-{slug}" style="display:none">')

    for pkey, pval in h.PURPOSES:
        act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
        print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
        dd = h.filter_by_purpose(dd_all, pval)

        print("<h2>Data Storage Location</h2>")

        title_by_purpose = {
            "all": f"DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions<br>at {dept}",
            "scientific": f"Scientific DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions<br>at {dept}",
            "educational": f"Educational DMPs with TU/e Storage Solutions<br>at {dept}",
        }

        df = h.storage_split(dd)
        total = df["DMPs"].sum() or 1
        df = df.assign(Share=df["DMPs"] / total)
        df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
        storage_rate = df.loc[df["Category"] == "Using TU/e storage", "Share"].iloc[0] if len(df) else 0
        storage_colors = {
            "Using TU/e storage": "#742459",
            "Not using TU/e storage": "#FAE1F0",
        }
        fig = px.pie(df, names="Category", values="DMPs", hole=0.55)
        fig.update_traces(text=df["Label"], textposition="outside", textinfo="text",
                          sort=False,
                          marker_colors=[storage_colors[c] for c in df["Category"]])
        fig.add_annotation(
            text=f"{storage_rate:.0%}",
            font={"size": 28, "color": "#111827"},
            showarrow=False,
        )
        fig.update_layout(showlegend=True,
                          title=title_by_purpose[pkey],
                          margin={"t": 80, "l": 20, "r": 20, "b": 20})
        print(h.render_chart(fig, width=500, height=450))

        df = h.storage_solution_by_department(dd)
        df = df[df["Department"] == dept]
        df = df.set_index("Solution")["DMPs"].reindex(sol_order, fill_value=0).reset_index(name="DMPs")
        df["Share"] = df["DMPs"] / (df["DMPs"].sum() or 1)
        df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
        df["Department"] = h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS[dept]
        short_map = {
            "TU/e Network Drive": "Network Drive",
            "SURF Research Drive": "SURF Drive",
            "Microsoft SharePoint/Teams": "SharePoint/Teams",
            "Microsoft OneDrive": "OneDrive",
        }
        df["Short"] = df["Solution"].map(short_map)
        fig = px.bar(df, x="Share", y="Department", color="Solution",
                     barmode="stack", orientation="h",
                     text=df["Short"], height=240,
                     category_orders={"Solution": sol_order},
                     color_discrete_map=solution_colors,
                     custom_data=df[["Label", "DMPs"]])
        fig.update_traces(texttemplate="%{text}<br>%{customdata[1]} (%{x:.0%})", textposition="inside",
                          textangle=0, insidetextanchor="middle",
                          hovertemplate="%{y} · %{fullData.name}<br>%{customdata[0]}<extra></extra>")
        fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="",
                          xaxis={"tickformat": ".0%", "title": "", "range": [0, 1]},
                          legend={"orientation": "h", "yanchor": "bottom", "y": 1.00,
                                  "xanchor": "left", "x": 0},
                          legend_title_text="",
                          margin={"t": 100},
                          title=f"TU/e Data Storage Choices at {dept}")
        print(h.render_chart(fig))
        print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>Note: Percentages are shares of storage '
              '<b>choices</b>, not of DMPs. A DMP can select multiple storage options.</i></p>')

        print("<h2>FAIR Data Adoption</h2>")

        df = h.trusted_repository_split(dd)
        total = df["DMPs"].sum() or 1
        df = df.assign(Share=df["DMPs"] / total)
        df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
        trusted_rate = df.loc[df["Category"] == "Using Trusted Repository", "Share"].iloc[0] if len(df) else 0
        trusted_colors = {
            "Using Trusted Repository": "#742459",
            "Not Using Trusted Repository": "#FAE1F0",
        }
        fig = px.pie(df, names="Category", values="DMPs", hole=0.55)
        fig.update_traces(text=df["Label"], textposition="outside", textinfo="text",
                          sort=False,
                          marker_colors=[trusted_colors[c] for c in df["Category"]])
        fig.add_annotation(
            text=f"{trusted_rate:.0%}",
            font={"size": 28, "color": "#111827"},
            showarrow=False,
        )
        fig.update_layout(showlegend=True,
                          title=f"DMPs indicating a use of a trusted repository for FAIR data <br>at {dept}",
                          margin={"t": 80, "l": 20, "r": 20, "b": 20})
        print(h.render_chart(fig, width=500, height=450))

        df = h.repository_breakdown(dd)
        df = df[df["Repository"].isin(repo_order)]
        df = df.set_index("Repository")["DMPs"].reindex(repo_order, fill_value=0).reset_index(name="DMPs")
        df["Share"] = df["DMPs"] / (df["DMPs"].sum() or 1)
        df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
        df["Department"] = h.DEPT_ABBREVIATIONS[dept]
        df["Short"] = df["Repository"].map({"4TU.ResearchData": "4TU"})
        df["Short"] = df["Short"].fillna(df["Repository"])
        fig = px.bar(df, x="Share", y="Department", color="Repository",
                     barmode="stack", orientation="h",
                     text=df["Short"], height=240,
                     category_orders={"Repository": repo_order},
                     color_discrete_map=repo_colors,
                     custom_data=df[["Label", "DMPs"]])
        fig.update_traces(texttemplate="%{text}<br>%{customdata[1]} (%{x:.0%})", textposition="inside",
                          textangle=0, insidetextanchor="middle",
                          hovertemplate="%{y} · %{fullData.name}<br>%{customdata[0]}<extra></extra>")
        fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="",
                          xaxis={"tickformat": ".0%", "title": "", "range": [0, 1]},
                          legend={"orientation": "h", "yanchor": "bottom", "y": 1.00,
                                  "xanchor": "left", "x": 0},
                          legend_title_text="",
                          margin={"t": 100},
                          title=f"Trusted repository choice in {dept}")
        print(h.render_chart(fig))
        print('<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280"><i>Note: Percentages are shares of repository '
              '<b>choices</b>, not of DMPs. A DMP can select multiple repositories. Data only include choices indicating a use of a trusted repository. Trusted repositories included here are: 4TU.ResearchData, Zenodo, OSF, Figshare.</i></p>')

        print("<h2>Archive location</h2>")

        df = h.archive_split(dd)
        total = df["DMPs"].sum() or 1
        df = df.assign(Share=df["DMPs"] / total)
        df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
        archive_rate = df.loc[df["Category"] == "Using TU/e archive", "Share"].iloc[0] if len(df) else 0
        archive_colors = {
            "Using TU/e archive": "#742459",
            "Not using TU/e archive": "#FAE1F0",
        }
        fig = px.pie(df, names="Category", values="DMPs", hole=0.55)
        fig.update_traces(text=df["Label"], textposition="outside", textinfo="text",
                          sort=False,
                          marker_colors=[archive_colors[c] for c in df["Category"]])
        fig.add_annotation(
            text=f"{archive_rate:.0%}",
            font={"size": 28, "color": "#111827"},
            showarrow=False,
        )
        fig.update_layout(showlegend=True,
                          title=f"DMPs indicating the use of TU/e archive (RAPS)<br>at {dept}",
                          margin={"t": 80, "l": 20, "r": 20, "b": 20})
        print(h.render_chart(fig, width=500, height=450))

        print('</div>')
    print('</div>')
```

## How to improve the implementation for the next year, 2026-2027

### What we can do: Boost FAIR data adoption

At Data Steward Team, we started the [FAIR Data
Clinic](https://rdm.tue.nl/docs/learning-resources/fair-clinic/) where
researchers get personalised advice on how to make their data more FAIR.

### What you can do

Please feel free to reach out to the Data Steward team. We can give
presentations about FAIR data and repositories.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById("dept-select");
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".dept-panel");
  function show(slug) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
    var target = document.getElementById("dept-" + slug);
    if (target) target.style.display = "";
  }
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var init = params.get("dept");
  if (init) { sel.value = init; show(init); }
  else { show(sel.value); }
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    show(this.value);
    params.set("dept", this.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
  });

  var purposeToggle = document.querySelector(".purpose-toggle");
  if (purposeToggle) {
    var pBtns = purposeToggle.querySelectorAll(".purpose-btn");
    var pPanels = document.querySelectorAll(".purpose-content");
    function showPurpose(p) {
      pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.purpose === p); });
      pPanels.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.toggle("purpose-active", el.dataset.purpose === p); });
    }
    pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { showPurpose(this.dataset.purpose); }); });
    showPurpose("all");
  }
});
</script>
